selected.name: DuckDB
selected.rationale: An embedded analytical database used in the market data warehouse architecture for local, high-performance querying of Parquet-based financial data lakes. Highly suitable for local quant research and rapid backtesting of historical OHLCV data.

selected.name: ClickHouse
selected.rationale: An open-source, column-oriented OLAP database used for large-scale financial data aggregation and concurrent queries, serving as the high-concurrency production warehouse layer for massive tick-level data.

selected.name: market-data-warehouse
selected.rationale: A local-first, multi-asset financial data warehouse blueprint that utilizes Parquet, DuckDB, and ClickHouse to build structured data pipelines (Raw, Bronze, Silver, Gold), ideal for structuring a custom Indian market data lake.
